svg.aria-label: A star and Dijkstra racing across the same warehouse floor: both find the same 59 step route, A star by examining 89 cells and Dijkstra 395, of a 408 cell floor
svg.title: Two Ways to Find a Route
svg.text: TWO WAYS TO FIND A ROUTE
SAME FLOOR · SAME START · SAME GOAL · ONE OF THEM KNOWS WHICH WAY TO LOOK
GUIDED BY A HEURISTIC · PREFERS CELLS THAT LOOK CLOSER TO THE GOAL
NO HEURISTIC · EXPANDS EVERY DIRECTION EQUALLY UNTIL IT ARRIVES
WHERE SEVERAL SHORTEST ROUTES EXIST EACH SEARCH RETURNS WHICHEVER IT REACHED FIRST · BOTH ARE OPTIMAL · THE HEURISTIC IS WHY ONE FINISHED SO MUCH SOONER
